tools.name: salesdrive_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (заявки) with their status, contact, products, delivery and payment fields. Filter by status, order number range, change date, order date or organization. At most 100 per page. SalesDrive API: GET /api/order/list/.

tools.name: salesdrive_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its order number. Returns the order object, or a message when no order has that number. SalesDrive API: GET /api/order/list/ with filter[id].

tools.name: salesdrive_list_statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses of the account with their ids and type (1 in progress, 2 sale, 3 unsuccessful, 4 deleted). Use the ids in salesdrive_update_order. SalesDrive API: GET /api/statuses/.

tools.name: salesdrive_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods of the account with their ids. SalesDrive API: GET /api/payment-methods/.

tools.name: salesdrive_list_delivery_methods
tools.description: List the delivery methods of the account with their ids. SalesDrive API: GET /api/delivery-methods/.

tools.name: salesdrive_find_contact_by_phone
tools.description: Find the client and the responsible manager for a phone number. Returns the manager (name, internal number) and the client record, if one matches. SalesDrive API: GET /api/get_manager_by_phone_number/.

tools.name: salesdrive_update_order
tools.description: Update an order's fields, for example statusId (order status), salesdrive_manager (responsible manager), comment, or paymentDate. Give order_id or external_id. Sends only the fields you pass. The API cannot change the city, branch or address of a Nova Poshta or Ukrposhta delivery. SalesDrive API: PO

tools.name: salesdrive_add_order_note
tools.description: Add a note to an order's client communications block. The note gets the current time. Each call adds a new note. SalesDrive API: POST /api/order/note/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: salesdrive_get_order · Private data: salesdrive_list_orders, salesdrive_find_contact_by_phone · Public sink: salesdrive_update_order, salesdrive_add_order_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: salesdrive_get_order · Private data: salesdrive_list_orders, salesdrive_find_contact_by_phone · Public sink: salesdrive_update_order, salesdrive_add_order_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
